generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

Satisfactorily completed Minimum one contract as a prime contract for LT motor rewinding works on rate contract basis for any PSU or government undertaking or co-operative sector in last Three years and the contract value not less than 12 Lakhs OR two contracts as prime contract with each contract valve not less than 06 Lakhs each.

The Bidder should be an authorized Service center of motor manufacturers or established firm having all the facilities engaged in rewinding of burnt motors and shall be in successful operation for at least last Three years as on the date of bid opening.
Documents in respect of achievement in last two Financial years out of Last three years a Minimum each year financial turnover not less than Rs. 12 Lakhs.
